description: 技术交底书生成。当用户要写技术交底书、专利交底、把研发材料或技术方案整理成交底书、挖专利点、只有一个想法想看看能往哪几个方向申请，或说「帮我写个交底书」「专利挖掘」「发明专利交底书」「交底书模板」「这个能写成专利吗」时使用。所用模型全部国产，国外模型 0 使用。Use when the user wants to turn R&D materials or an idea into a patent technical disclosure (invention disclosure) document (Word). All models are made in China; no foreign models are used.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
